answer: Weakest link is identity cost: fresh keys are free, so farms mint them. Bind each agent to a stake of ferrous tokens smelted from verified compute, plus reputation written to a reef-anchored ledger. New keys inherit no history, only a starting ripple of zero, so multiplying identities multiplies locked cost without multiplying trust. Forge the work proofs and you still burn stake before any payout clears — a farm costs more than the honest agent it mimics.
